questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

Adverbial phrase: Only after the meeting did they realize the gravity of the situation.
options: Only after the meeting did they realize the gravity of the situation.
After the meeting only did they realize the gravity of the situation.
Only after the meeting realized they the gravity of the situation.
After the meeting only realized they the gravity of the situation.
questions.answer: Only after the meeting did they realize the gravity of the situation.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?

Specific detail: The discovery of penicillin was Fleming's most significant contribution.
options: It was Fleming who discovered penicillin in 1928.
Fleming's most significant contribution was the discovery of penicillin.
That penicillin was discovered by Fleming was in 1928.
The discovery of penicillin Fleming made in 1928 was significant.
questions.answer: It was Fleming who discovered penicillin in 1928.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the conditional sentence that expresses a hypothetical situation in the past which is unlikely to have occurred.

Base sentence: If he had known about the meeting, he would have attended.

Alternative form:
options: If he had known about the meeting, he would have attended.
Had he known about the meeting, he would have attended.
If he knew about the meeting, he would have attended.
Had he known about the meeting, he would attend.
questions.answer: Had he known about the meeting, he would have attended.

questions.question:
Choose the sentence that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation.

Base sentence: We recommend that patients take the medication twice daily.

Alternative form:
options: We recommend that patients take the medication twice daily.
We recommend that patients should take the medication twice daily.
We recommend that patients taking the medication twice daily.
We recommend that patients must take the medication twice daily.
questions.answer: We recommend that patients take the medication twice daily.

questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence that demonstrates ellipsis, where a word is omitted but understood from context.

Context: The committee approved the proposal, whereas the board disapproved it.

Ellipsis sentence:
options: The committee approved the proposal, whereas the board disapproved it.
The committee approved the proposal, whereas the board disapproved.
The committee approved the proposal, whereas the board disapproved it not.
The committee approved the proposal, whereas the board disapproved it of.
questions.answer: The committee approved the proposal, whereas the board disapproved.
